top_news.title: Experts Rise Where LLMs Disagree: Using Cross-Model Disagreement to Target Expert Effort in LLM Codebook Revision for Large-Scale Annotation
top_news.dek: Researchers propose using cross-model disagreement to identify ambiguous data points, allowing experts to focus on refining codebooks for large-scale annotation.
top_news.brief: Developing robust codebooks for large-scale annotation is time-consuming. This study suggests using LLM disagreement to surface complex cases, enabling experts to provide targeted feedback. This approach aims to improve annotation quality and efficiency by prioritizing human effort where models struggle to reach a consensus.

top_news.title: Introducing NV-Reason-CT Open 3D CT VLM for Radiologist Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
top_news.dek: NVIDIA introduced NV-Reason-CT, a vision-language model designed for 3D CT scans to support radiologist chain-of-thought reasoning.
top_news.brief: General-purpose VLMs often struggle with volumetric medical imaging. NV-Reason-CT is specifically built to handle 3D CT data, providing the multi-step conversational depth required for radiologists to verify AI-generated findings and improve diagnostic trust.
top_news.image_alt: 3D CT scan visualization with AI analysis overlay

top_news.title: Automating coherent long-form video generation
top_news.dek: Google Research addresses semantic drift and cascading failures in long-form video generation pipelines.
top_news.brief: Current video diffusion models struggle to maintain consistency across long-form content. Google is investigating how to mitigate semantic drift and cascading failures that occur when chaining independent modules, aiming to improve the reliability of automated storytelling engines.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing video diffusion pipeline modules

top_news.title: Google's first Suncatcher orbital data center test launches October 1
top_news.dek: Google is launching its experimental Suncatcher orbital data center test on October 1.
top_news.brief: The Suncatcher project will test orbital data processing with a configuration featuring four TPUs. The experimental unit is designed for short, 15-minute operational bursts in space.
top_news.image_alt: Artist rendering of the Suncatcher orbital data center

top_news.title: Combining Machine Learning and Homomorphic Encryption in the Apple Ecosystem
top_news.dek: Apple integrates homomorphic encryption with machine learning to enable private visual search.
top_news.brief: Apple is utilizing Private Nearest Neighbor Search to perform visual search tasks on photos while maintaining user privacy. By combining homomorphic encryption with on-device processing, the system minimizes data exposure to external servers.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual visualization of private visual search processing

primary.title: Contrastive-LM Releases CLM-8B: An Open System One Model That Scores Agent Actions Up to 9× Faster Than Jev
primary.summary: Contrastive-LM has released CLM-8B, an open System One model that scores candidate actions against a state instead of generating text. It adds 2 small projection heads to a frozen Qwen3-8B encoder and trains them with a contrastive InfoNCE objective. In zero-shot tests it runs up to 9× faster than TypeSafe's Jev. With fine-tuned heads as a verifier, it reaches 81.6% on held-out DeepSWE tasks and 87.6% on held-out Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks. primary.title: Use open weight models as your AI coding agent with Amazon Bedrock
primary.summary: Pair OpenCode, an open-source terminal-native AI coding agent, with open weight models on Amazon Bedrock to get a secure, flexible, pay-per-use coding assistant. Learn how to configure multi-model workflows, match the right model to each task, and keep your data in your own AWS account with no infrastructure to manage.
